rules.rule: Band 1 or 2: analyst closes under delegated authority
Band 3 or 4: Risk Committee decides; quorum 3; simple majority; votes hidden until all cast
Boundary flag (within 0.5 of the next band edge): analyst must acknowledge before release
Fast lane: screening agent proposes when the only change type is a vendor renewal or a feature with no new geography, segment or product and annual volume under $5M; analyst confirms; Band 1 expected
Auto-triage: new cases to the analyst with the fewest open cases
Committee question to the analyst: thread visible to all members; answer attached as a pack addendum; a number change requires unlock with reason, pack v2, votes re-requested

examiner.question: Why was FCRM-2026-0151 routed to committee instead of closed by the analyst?

sentences.t: The composite residual was first computed at 9.8, Band 2, which would have closed under delegated authority.
The boundary flag was raised because 9.8 sits 0.3 below the Band 3 edge.
The critic flagged the vendor due-diligence rating of 7.6 as 2.7 above the precedent average of 4.9, with evidence limited to a 2023 domestic-scope audit.
Analyst Rahul Iyer overrode the rating to 4.5 with the reason “audit predates the corridor arrangement”.
The engine recomputed to 10.4, Band 3, which routes to committee under routing rules v4.
The band change and boundary flag were acknowledged.
The committee approved with conditions by 2 to 1.
